Contributing to posc

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for your interest in posc. Contributions of all kinds are welcome: bug reports, questions, documentation fixes and new features.

Reporting a problem

Open an issue at https://github.com/MatthewBJane/posc/issues. Please include a minimal reproducible example (the smallest piece of code and data that shows the problem), the output you got, the output you expected, and the result of sessionInfo(). If the problem is with a plot, attach the image.

Asking for help

Questions about using the package, or about probability of outcome superiority curves themselves, are also welcome as issues. Label them as a question. The documentation website at https://matthewbjane.com/posc/ has the function reference and a longer manuscript that derives the curves.

Suggesting a change

For a small fix (a typo, a clearer error message, a documentation example), open a pull request directly. For anything larger, open an issue first so that we can agree on the approach before you spend time on it.

To work on the package:

# install.packages(c("devtools", "testthat"))
devtools::load_all()      # load the development version
devtools::test()          # run the tests
devtools::document()      # rebuild the help files after changing roxygen comments
devtools::check()         # full R CMD check before opening a pull request

Please add a test for any new behaviour, keep the existing tests passing, and follow the style of the surrounding code (two-space indentation, snake_case names, roxygen2 documentation for every exported function). Add a line to NEWS.md under the development version describing the change.

Code of conduct

Be respectful and constructive. Reports of unacceptable behaviour can be sent to the maintainer at matthewbjane@gmail.com.
